item.title: Paris Summer Olympic Games 2024 Dashboard
item.description:
GitHub Repository · Kaggle Dataset

Overview

The Paris 2024 Summer Olympic Games featured over 10,500 athletes competing across 32 sports and 329 medal events. This Power BI dashboard aggregates competition records into interactive views exploring country medal tallies, gender parity in podium finishes, individual athlete records, and multi-year historical trends.

The report contains five interconnected pages with dynamic cross-filtering by sport, country, and event.

Dashboard Pages

1. Home & Navigation

The landing screen provides a high-level visual intro and direct navigation links across the four core analytical modules.

2. Medal Overview & Geographic Distribution

This page summarizes total medal counts, gold-to-bronze distributions, and global medal density.

  • Medals by Country & Gender: Stacked bar charts showing the balance of medals won by male and female athletes across participating nations.
  • Choropleth Map: Visualizes medal density worldwide, highlighting regional strongholds in specific athletic disciplines.
  • Game-Wise Slicers: Allows filtering all charts simultaneously by selecting individual sports (e.g., Athletics, Swimming, Gymnastics).

3. Athlete Performance & Disciplines

A dedicated athlete directory exploring individual performances, multiple medalists, and sport-specific achievements.

  • Athlete Roster: Searchable table listing athletes with their nationality, events entered, and medal outcomes.
  • Multi-Medal Winners: Highlights top competitors who secured podium placements across multiple individual or team events.
  • Filters: Drill down by country, sporting discipline, gender, or medal type.

4. Country Profiles

An in-depth breakdown of individual National Olympic Committees (NOCs) and their medal composition.

  • National Leaderboard: Compares official IOC ranking (sorted by gold medal priority) with total medal count.
  • Discipline Strengths: Identifies which sports contributed the largest share of a country’s total medal haul.
  • Podium Conversion: Visualizes the ratio of finals reached to medals won.

5. Historical Context & Multi-Games Trends

Places Paris 2024 in context by comparing national performance against historical Olympic Games.

  • Historical Medal Trajectories: Line charts tracking how nations have trended over multiple modern Olympic editions.
  • Emerging Contenders: Flags countries achieving their first-ever Olympic medals or record-high medal totals in 2024.

Key DAX Measures

  • Total Medals: COUNTROWS(Medals)
  • Gold Medal Ratio: DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Medals), Medals[Medal] = "Gold"), [Total Medals], 0)
  • Weighted Medal Score: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Medals), Medals[Medal] = "Gold") * 3 + CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Medals), Medals[Medal] = "Silver") * 2 + CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Medals), Medals[Medal] = "Bronze")

Data Sources

  • Competition Data: Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games Dataset on Kaggle
  • Historical Records: Official Olympic database references via Olympics.com

item.title: Visualizing Microsoft AdventureWorks Data
item.description:
GitHub Repository

Overview

AdventureWorks is Microsoft’s standard relational sample database representing a multinational bicycle manufacturing and retail company. This Power BI dashboard tracks commercial performance across products, sales territories, and customer segments, turning transactional sales records into operational reporting.

The report is organized into three focused pages covering sales volume, target tracking, and customer demographics.

Dashboard Pages

1. Sales Overview

The executive overview summarizes top-line revenue, order counts, return rates, and product category distribution.

  • Revenue by Category: Breaks down total sales across Bikes, Components, Clothing, and Accessories.
  • Geographical Distribution: Maps revenue across sales regions in North America, Europe, and Australia.
  • Returns Tracking: Highlights product categories with above-average return rates to identify potential quality or fulfillment issues.
  • Dynamic Slicers: Allows filtering by product category, subcategory, territory, and transaction date range.

2. Performance Metrics & Target Tracking

This view compares actual monthly operational figures against management targets to monitor pacing and profitability.

  • Actual vs. Target KPIs: Gauge charts and status cards comparing current-month performance against budgeted targets for orders, revenue, and returns.
  • Trend Analysis: Weekly rolling profit and revenue trendlines tracking seasonal fluctuations and growth trajectory.
  • Variance Indicators: Color-coded KPI cards indicating whether key metrics are ahead or behind scheduled goals.

3. Customer Analytics & Segmentation

The customer intelligence page analyzes purchasing habits across demographic attributes to profile core customer cohorts.

  • Income and Occupation: Revenue distribution across annual income brackets and professional occupations (Management, Professional, Skilled Manual, Clerical).
  • Demographic Breakdown: Customer segmentation by age group, marital status, and gender.
  • Purchase Frequency: Tracks average spend per customer and order repetition rates.

Data Model & DAX Measures

The underlying data model follows a star schema connecting transactional fact tables (Sales and Returns) to dimension tables (Customer, Product, Territory, and Calendar).

Key DAX measures include:

  • Total Revenue: SUMX(Sales, Sales[OrderQuantity] * Sales[UnitPrice])
  • Total Profit: [Total Revenue] - SUMX(Sales, Sales[OrderQuantity] * Sales[TotalProductCost])
  • Return Rate %: DIVIDE(COUNT(Returns[ReturnQuantity]), COUNT(Sales[OrderQuantity]), 0)
  • Revenue Variance to Target: [Total Revenue] - [Target Revenue]

Cross-filtering is enabled across all visualizations, and users can drill down from parent product categories into specific product models.

Data Source

  • Dataset: Microsoft AdventureWorks Sample Data

item.title: Starbucks Drinks Dashboard
item.description:
GitHub Repository

Note on Data: This project was developed as an exploratory data visualization study using simulated beverage metrics and location data to model commercial nutritional reporting.

Overview

Modern beverage menus span hundreds of customized variations across milk bases, sweeteners, and portion sizes. This Power BI dashboard provides structured reporting on beverage nutrition, breaking down calorie counts, sugar loads, macronutrient splits, and global store presence across four analytical pages.

Dashboard Pages

1. Beverage Portfolio Overview

The introductory page provides an aggregate view of the beverage menu across major drink categories (Espresso, Brewed Coffee, Frappuccino, Tea, and Cold Brew).

  • Menu Composition: Distribution of drink offerings by category and available cup sizes (Short, Tall, Grande, Venti).
  • Macronutrient Averages: Baseline calorie, protein, fat, and carbohydrate levels averaged by beverage line.
  • Top Ranks: Quick-reference cards highlighting beverages with the highest and lowest calorie counts per category.

2. Nutritional Profiles & Macronutrients

A comparative view breaking down primary dietary macronutrients across drinks.

  • Fat and Protein Comparisons: Scatter plots and grouped bar charts comparing protein content against total fat across dairy and plant-based milk formulations.
  • Serving Size Normalization: Visualizations that adjust metric comparisons based on fluid volume (caloric density per ounce).
  • Category Slicers: Interactive filters enabling users to compare specific drink subcategories side-by-side.

3. Critical Health Indicators & Sugar Mapping

Focuses on dietary risk factors that consumers and health analysts monitor closely: added sugars, sodium, trans fats, and caffeine.

  • Sugar Content Distribution: Identifies beverages that exceed recommended daily sugar intakes in a single serving.
  • Trans & Saturated Fat Flags: Highlights drinks with elevated saturated fat levels resulting from whipped cream or whole milk preparations.
  • Color-Coded Thresholds: Conditional formatting on tables and KPI cards flagging nutritional extremes.

4. Store Distribution Map

Visualizes store network coverage across international territories.

  • Global Footprint: Geographic plot showing store concentrations across regions.
  • Regional Aggregation: Drill-down from continent and country to local market clusters.

Key DAX Calculations

  • Average Calories per Drink: AVERAGE(Beverages[Calories])
  • Sugar-to-Calorie Ratio: DIVIDE(SUM(Beverages[Sugars_g]) * 4, SUM(Beverages[Calories]), 0)
  • High-Sugar Flag: IF(Beverages[Sugars_g] > 30, "Above 30g", "30g or Below")
